Criterion B1 (re-experiencing): MET — patient reported intense recollections and physical reactions when reminded of the event. Criterion B2 (avoidance of thoughts): MET — patient stated they avoid thinking about the details of the event. Criterion B3 (avoidance of reminders): MET — patient avoids places and situations that remind them of the event. Criterion C1 (inability to recall details): MET — patient mentioned gaps in memory about the event. Criterion C2 (negative beliefs): MET — patient expressed a shift to more negative thoughts about themselves and others. Criterion C3 (blame): MET — patient reported blaming themselves in unreasonable ways for the trauma. Criterion C4 (negative emotions): MET — patient described frequent feelings of fear and anxiety. Criterion C5 (diminished interest): MET — patient noted a lack of interest in previously meaningful activities. Criterion C6 (detachment): MET — patient feels a noticeable distance from others. Criterion C7 (inability to experience positive feelings): MET — patient finds it difficult to experience good feelings. Criterion D1 (irritability): MET — patient experiences irritability and anger outbursts regularly. Criterion D2 (recklessness): MET — patient reported engaging in riskier behaviors more frequently. Criterion D3 (hypervigilance): MET — patient feels more alert and on edge. Criterion D4 (startle response): MET — patient is more easily startled. Criterion D5 (concentration difficulties): MET — patient has difficulty concentrating. Criterion D6 (sleep disturbances): MET — patient has difficulty sleeping. Criterion E (duration): MET — symptoms began after the traumatic event and have lasted for more than a month. Criterion F (functional impairment): MET — patient reported significant distress and interference with work and social interactions. Criterion G (exclusion): MET — patient denied substance use or medical conditions that could explain symptoms. Total: 14 of 14 criteria met (threshold ≥1). Diagnosis: TRUE — full criteria for PTSD are met with significant functional impairment confirmed.
